acceptance_predicates.description: Every public ASB command and alias accepts -q/--quiet in any permitted option position and it suppresses ASB human operational output without changing effects, exits, or structured results.
Every human operational line starts with a documented fixed-width four-cell state token whose meaning is available without color; terminal color follows the specified success/error/warning semantics.
--json emits no human status, update, or progress output on stdout or stderr while preserving the exact versioned JSON and exit contracts.
Quiet does not remove required interactive input or suppress the launched TUI application; it only suppresses ASB lifecycle presentation.
Rendering is concise, plain-text safe when redirected, secret/private-data safe, and leaves raw protocol and terminal ownership contracts intact.

definition_of_done: Contract and parser/rendering tests cover every public command family and early error path.
Documentation gives exact behavior for human, quiet, redirected, JSON, interactive, and TUI modes.
Independent review, exact-head checks, signed merge, and exact-main evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1768 human presentation, severity, stream, privacy, and remediation behavior.
Existing JSON/stdout and diagnostic/stderr compatibility contract.

outputs.description: Closed human status token, color, stream, and mode contract.
Global quiet parsing and behavior contract for all public command routes.

gates.description: Quiet and JSON mode tests prove silence while human terminal and redirected renderings retain stable fixed-width state tokens.
Authoritative public command inventory and early error paths are fully covered.
JSON, exits, protocol, privacy, prompt, and TUI ownership contracts remain compatible.
